title: About Us
contentHtml:
We are a 100% volunteer-run NYC makerspace
located in the heart of New York City’s Greenwich Village.

Our mission — to share the magic of making to inspire everyone to grow.

Open to Members 24/7!

Visitors: please only come during our scheduled events

Since 2013, Fat Cat Fab Lab is a hub for artists, students, engineers, hobbyists, startups, and meetups to gather and grow through 3D printing, laser cutting, CNC routing, sewing, electronics, photography, and more.

Location:

224 W. 4th St.
Second Floor, Suite 206 (Buzzer #6)
New York, NY 10014

Volunteer with us!

Everything moves faster with more hands on deck.

  • We need members! We'd love if you, or someone you know wants to be a member!

  • Teach a class! If it’s free, great! If you’d like to make a little, we can work with that too. We’ll provide the space, you bring the class!

  • Learn how to repair equipment to improve our facilities!

  • Donate or help us find equipment we need!

  • Not quite ready to join? Stay informed by subscribing to our newsletter.

  • Attend a class! Check out our Classes & Events and Meetup Events. If you don’t see a class you’re looking for, let us know.

Thank you!

It’s no small task organizing and running a fab lab in New York City! We’re an all volunteer organization run by members. Any extra help is really appreciated.

title: FAQs
contentHtml:
FAQs

What are your hours?

Visitors, please check out our Meetup group for Open Hours and events, and our classes page. Please RSVP to attend.

Members have access to the space 24/7 - One of the most unique offerings in NYC!

Do I have to know how to use the equipment?

If you're not familiar with a certain tool there's very often people around willing to help you out in person or on our Slack channel. If you'd like to use some of the fancier tools on your own (Laser Cutter, CNC Router, etc) members must go through simple safety and usage training which happens on a regular schedule.

How much is membership?

We have 3 membership levels:

  • Standard: $110/mo for personal use. Storage bins are available for $30 (32qt) and $60 (70qt).

  • Premium: $220/mo for coworking use. Storage bins are available for $30 (32qt) and $60 (70qt).

  • Student: $99/mo for personal use. Storage bins are available for $27 (32qt) and $54 (70qt).

For full information visit our Membership page or visit our wiki.

What is a Premium membership?

You must pay for a Premium membership if you fall under the following categories:

  • Your employer is paying for the membership.

  • You are doing work for the purposes of a corporation, self-owned, or otherwise.

  • Using the space as a daily workplace.

  • You use more than 3 hours of job time on equipment like the Laser Cutter or CNC

We reserve the right to re-classify membership status depending on usage.

Can I donate equipment in exchange for membership dues?

Sorry, we don’t do this.

Can I book a tour for my school/company/organization?

Absolutely. Send us a message here with a short description about your group and we'll do our best to accommodate your needs.

How long have you been around?

We started hosting meetups in 2013 in a small office space. In 2015 we expanded in to our current space and started offering membership.

Are you related to the Jazz club Fat Cat?

Although we are an entirely separate organization, Fat Cat Fab Lab was originally started in 2013 by the owners of Fat Cat Jazz Bar as a community project. Fat Cat Jazz Bar closed permanently during the covid-19 pandemic.

What is your refund policy for events, such as workshops/classes/courses?

We offer no refunds.

Where can I find the important FCFL member documents?

  • Membership Terms & Waiver

  • Membership Orientation & Responsibilities

  • Rules & Policies

title: Guest pass
contentHtml:
Hosting guests at the lab

We love it when members give tours of the lab! It really helps us grow and gets other people excited about what we're doing.

But what about other kinds of visits where you need someome who is not a current member to work or be with you at the lab? 

You can get a day pass for them!

Current Fat Cat Fab Lab members may purchase a Guest Day Pass for a non-member.

Please have them sign a waiver.

Reminder: you are responsible for your guest and should make sure they follow our Rules and Policies.

title: Laser Cutter
contentHtml:
Trotec Speedy 300 Laser Cutter

Our laser cutter is a Trotec Speedy 300. With 80 watts of power, this CO2 laser can be used to cut or engrave a wide variety of materials: wood, acrylic, glass, paper, fabric, leather, etc.  

LASER TYPE: 80 Watt CO2 laser
WORK AREA: 29 x 17 inch (736 x 431 mm)
MAX HEIGHT: 7 inches (177 mm)

RESOURCES

  • More info about our laser machine on the wiki

  • Trotec product details

  • FCFL Approved Materials List

title: CNC Router
contentHtml:
CamMaster Stinger 1 CNC Router

Our 3 axis CNC Router is a CamMaster Stinger 1. Great for working with woods, plastics, and soft metals like aluminum, copper, and bronze.

WORK AREA: 25 x 36 inch (635 x 914 mm)
MAX DEPTH: 5 inches (127 mm)
SPINDLE POWER: 2.28 HP (1.7 kW)
MAX RPM: 18,000
MAX CUT SPEED: 350 in/min (8890 mm/min)
REPEATABILITY: ±0.001 in (±0.0254 mm)
COLLET: ER25

RESOURCES

  • Official product page

  • More info about our CNC router on the wiki
